task: SNLI 3-class NLI; not causal effect identification
pairing: Identical initialized tensors, parameter counts, shuffle and dropout RNG paths within each seed; all arms compute both directions and auxiliary losses
checkpoint: Final epoch only; same four epochs as V2; no mid-run tuning
selection: After all training, select aligned_ce or aligned_logic by mean final official-dev accuracy across all three seeds; ties choose aligned_ce; default inference seed17 fixed
evaluation_order: Write training_complete and dev-only selection before evaluating holdout or official test
holdout: 6000 previously unused official-train examples; strongest feasible group exclusion in holdout_manifest; same-domain audit, not a new benchmark
official_test: Previously exposed during V1 and V2; report only as exploratory regression evidence
confidence_interval: Paired group bootstrap conditional on three fitted seed pairs; report all per-seed differences, not population seed uncertainty
